title: Cyber Security Act Replaces DSA
subtitle: The government replaced the 2018 DSA amid sustained criticism, while debate over free expression persisted.
summary: In 2023, Bangladesh enacted the Cyber Security Act replacing the Digital Security Act 2018. Critics and rights groups debated whether key coercive provisions were meaningfully reduced or largely retained under a new legal label.
heroTagline: The government replaced the 2018 DSA amid sustained criticism, while debate over free expression persisted.
whyItMatters: The replacement matters because it tests whether legal reform in Bangladesh changes enforcement practice or mainly repackages existing control logics.
